nodes.title: IMPORTANT - SOURCE VIDEO
widgets_values:
POSE TRANSFER WORKFLOW

Upload the motion-reference video here. DWPose converts every frame to a pose guide.

IMPORTANT: the control-frame count must match the H3 generation length. This workflow's normal 5-second setting produces 124 H3 frames. For the first test, use a source clip that yields 124 frames at 24 fps (about 5.17 seconds), or set the H3 duration/length to match the pose batch.

nodes.title: 4. Match Pose Frames to H3 Resolution

widgets_values:
For the target video, <Picture 1> defines the target subject appearance, face, identity, and clothing. 

integrated_multimodal_description:
[Shot 1] Cinematic live-action video of the woman from <Picture 1> dancing dynamically on a wide, open city plaza street. The camera frames her in a medium shot, tracking her fluid body movements accurately based on the motion paths from <Video 1>. 

She remains consistently styled as shown in <Picture 1>, wearing her black lace bralette tank top crop top paired with high-waisted white casual athletic shorts. Her voluminous, long dark wavy hair dynamically flows and bounces with her dance movements. Realistic skin texture, distinct facial expressions, and sharp details are fully preserved from <Picture 1>.

The background environment features towering skyscraper office buildings softly blurred by cinematic depth of field. Natural, clear daylight illuminates the entire scene, casting soft shadows across the plaza tiles. Photorealistic, 8k resolution, crisp focus, smooth continuous camera tracking following the subject.
